TRIED.definition: Tested and proved useful or correct.

TREND.gloss: a general direction in which something tends to move
TREND.definition: A general direction in which something tends to move.

INTER.definition: Place in a grave or tomb.
INTER.example: Stalin was buried behind the Kremlin wall on Red Square.

DINER.definition: A person eating a meal (especially in a restaurant).

END.definition: Either extremity of something that has length.

DIE.definition: Pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life.

TEN.gloss: the cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one
TEN.definition: The cardinal number that is the sum of nine and one; the base of the decimal system.

RIDE.gloss: sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions
RIDE.definition: Sit and travel on the back of animal, usually while controlling its motions.

NET.gloss: a computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the…
NET.definition: A computer network consisting of a worldwide network of computer networks that use the TCP/IP network protocols to facilitate data transmission and exchange.

RENT.example: We rented our apartment to friends while we were abroad.

TEND.gloss: have a tendency or disposition to do or be something
TEND.definition: Have a tendency or disposition to do or be something; be inclined.
TEND.example: She tends to be nervous before her lectures.

TIE.gloss: neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn under a collar and tied in…
TIE.definition: Neckwear consisting of a long narrow piece of material worn (mostly by men) under a collar and tied in knot at the front.
TIE.example: He stood in front of the mirror tightening his necktie.
